samples.question: Start at the red ring and follow the single dark trail to the gold triangle. Imagine the straight chord joining their centers. Number the seven cyan beads in travel order. Reflect beads 2, 4, and 6 across that chord; leave beads 1, 3, 5, and 7 fixed, then reconnect the endpoints and beads in order. Which path appears: arch (one bulge on the left-hand side as you travel red to gold), cup (one bulge on the right-hand side), or wave (one bulge on each side)?
